categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.

rules.rationale: D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TOOLING_AMBIENT_EXCLUDED_PATHS = {.workflow-manager/installation.json}, an exact-path, release-derived terminal fallback that classify_path and classify_path_implementation_stage consult only after every declared classification has failed, immediately before the UnclassifiedPathError raise. The frozen declared-classification semantics are untouched: a declaration still decides first, the constant never enters a hashed classification set, and the path never existed in any Workflow payload or in the upstream repository the frozen classifier was written for -- so every digest 2.5.1 could compute is byte-identical and only a digest that raised because a committed workflow_manager update rewrote the installation record now returns (the legacy-item half of v2.4.0-001). D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): resolve_feedback_dir becomes the one authoritative resolver keyed on the durable feedback_layout stamp -- "scoped" items resolve .ai-review/<id>/feedback by construction, items without the stamp (or without a state entry or state file) keep the unchanged scoped-else-flat rule, an undecidable state file or unknown value refuses (FeedbackLayoutUndecidableError/UnknownFeedbackLayoutError); adds resolve_feedback_layout, ensure_feedback_dir (called by mark_functional_review_consumed), resolve_feedback_path_contract and the --resolve-feedback-path CLI; assert_feedback_not_owned_by_other_work_item gains an optional state for the bounded terminal-owner relaxation (legacy writers only); adds assert_manual_feedback_names_work_item.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TestToolingAmbientExcludedPaths -- fallback classification at both stages with a 2.5.1 control arm, explicit-protected precedence, sibling fail-closed paths, hashed-projection invariance, and digest invariance with the previously raising digests equal to their pre-update recorded values. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): adds TestFeedbackLayout (scoped-by-construction resolution, ensure_feedback_dir, the unchanged legacy rule for a legacy entry/no entry/no state file, undecidable-state and unknown-value refusals, no cross-item collision, the terminal-owner relaxation and its bounds, the per-item consumed marker, CLI/function equality for all three layouts, and the manual-record Work item: refusal). TestBundleLayoutResolver, TestFunctionalReviewConsumedMarker and TestReviewImplementationWritebackCrossWorkItemIsolation are re-pointed by docstring to their legacy scope; no assertion is removed.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TestImplementingEntryReachableAfterInstallationRecordUpdate -- a 2.3.1-shaped item stays implementing_entry_reachable after a committed installation-record change, with a 2.5.1 control arm that raises UnclassifiedPathError. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): adds TestFeedbackLayoutStamp -- fresh items and remediation children are stamped "scoped", resume never stamps or changes the field, validate_state accepts absent/"scoped" and refuses any other value.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): the Computing review_content_id section gains the classification paragraph naming the one release-derived fallback, where it sits in the classification order, and what stays fail-closed. D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): "Bundle structure" restates AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch to the working-tree anchor -- the base-plus-current-plus-declaration pathspec union, --no-renames, the provenance preamble, and its placement after MANIFEST.md -- and states it stays convenience only. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): "Bundle location" gains the normative "Feedback directory" subsection -- the durable stamp, the scoped/legacy/refused resolution, ensure_feedback_dir, the --resolve-feedback-path contract for external tools, the bounded ownership-guard relaxation and the manual-record binding; the flat-fallback sentences are narrowed to the bundle directory and the Feedback protocol's location note is restated.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): new design section carrying the problem, the decision, its release-derived authority, the identity-stability argument, the fail-closed boundary, the justification relative to the frozen plan-stage classifier, and the rejected alternatives. D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): the section's AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch paragraph gains a "Working-tree anchor" subsection -- why the ..HEAD form was always empty, the pathspec union and its reachable deletion/rename shapes, the provenance preamble, and consistency with the reviewed bytes. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): new design section -- problem, the stamp, the one resolver, directory creation, the external CLI contract, the bounded guard relaxation, manual-record binding, why legacy items are not moved, the mechanical downgrade evidence (2.5.1's validate_state ignores the key), and rejected alternatives.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2, v2.4.0-003): the AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch block drops ..HEAD and diffs amendment_base_commit against the working tree (--no-renames), over the sorted union of the plan_stage.protected_paths declared at amendment_base_commit, the ones declared now and <id>-artifacts.json itself; it gains a provenance preamble (work_item_id, amendment_id, amendment_base_commit, plan_revision, review_content_id) and moves after --write-manifest so the preamble can carry the manifest's review_content_id. The file stays outside current/ and outside both identities; the archive line and every other block are unchanged.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): adds TestPrepareAiReviewShAmendmentDiffWorkingTreeAnchor, driving the real prepare-ai-review.sh in scratch repositories -- uncommitted plan edit (with a ..HEAD control arm), untracked new protected file with the index restored, dropped-and-deleted path, rename as deletion plus new file, dropped-but-kept changed and unchanged paths, artifacts declaration absent at the base, non-protected edits absent, archive member byte-identity, bundle_id invariance, removal after resolution, preamble fields, and git apply --check at amendment_base_commit. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): step 4's note on AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch states the working-tree anchor, so the patch shows the still-uncommitted amended plan. The generator-mention wording workflow_integration_test.py's census pins (mention-only, no run/rerun invocation) is kept.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3; first overlay replacement of workflow_state.py): route_work_item's fresh-id branch and create_remediation_child_work_item stamp feedback_layout: "scoped" at creation (never on resume, never back-filled), and _validate_work_item (validate_state) refuses any present feedback_layout value other than "scoped" with UnknownFeedbackLayoutError. Nothing else changes.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): the feedback_dir() helper is re-pointed -- the matrix item is created through route_work_item, so it asserts the scoped layout and creates the directory through ensure_feedback_dir, the same call every production writer makes. No scenario changes.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): every hard-coded .ai-review/feedback/ path (REVIEWING_PLAN exit, REVISING_PLAN entry, implementation-review allowed actions and exit, functional-review exit and entry, the optional-reviewer paragraph, Feedback file locations) becomes <feedback_dir>, with one normative definition under Feedback file locations pointing at REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md "Feedback directory".
D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): the invariants list gains a Feedback location bullet (scoped-by-construction for new items, legacy resolution kept, the --resolve-feedback-path CLI).
